lines.zh: 我在屋檐上走，瓦片一片都没响。
lines.en: I walk the rooftops without rattling a single tile.

lines.zh: 夜色够浓，我才敢下到村路上。
lines.en: Only when the dark thickens do I drop to the road.

lines.zh: 我踩着月光走，影子先到门口。
lines.en: I walk in moonlight; my shadow reaches the door first.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，避开巡逻的火把。
lines.en: I hug the wall, avoiding the patrol torches.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过篱笆，像跨过一道线。
lines.en: I step over the fence as if it were a line.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，让猎物以为还有时间。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the prey thinks it has time.

lines.zh: 血的味道在前面，我的步子变快了。
lines.en: Blood lies ahead, and my pace quickens.

lines.zh: 我绕过井口，那里有圣水的味道。
lines.en: I skirt the well; holy water taints the air there.

lines.zh: 我在雪上不留脚印，只留一道黑影。
lines.en: I leave no prints in snow, only a dark streak.

lines.zh: 我穿过麦田，穗子自己让开。
lines.en: I cross the wheat, and the stalks part for me.

lines.zh: 我跟着牛车走，轮子声盖住我的脚步。
lines.en: I follow a cart; its wheels cover my steps.

lines.zh: 天边发白，我得在烧起来之前回去。
lines.en: The sky pales; I must be gone before it burns.

lines.zh: 我停在钟楼阴影里，等钟声过去。
lines.en: I wait in the bell tower's shadow for the chime to pass.

lines.zh: 我数着屋里的心跳，一共四个人。
lines.en: I count heartbeats inside: four people in all.

lines.zh: 我舔掉嘴角的血，味道有点旧。
lines.en: I lick blood from my lip; it tastes old.

lines.zh: 我挂在梁上，像一件没人要的外套。
lines.en: I hang from a beam like an unwanted coat.

lines.zh: 我听着狗叫，它闻到了我。
lines.en: I hear a dog bark; it has caught my scent.

lines.zh: 我把尖牙在石头上磨了磨。
lines.en: I grind my fangs against a stone.

lines.zh: 我数自己还剩几瓶血，只有两瓶。
lines.en: I count my blood vials; only two remain.

lines.zh: 我在等雾，雾起时没人看得见我。
lines.en: I wait for fog; no one sees me once it rises.

lines.zh: 我的护符发烫，附近有银。
lines.en: My amulet warms; there is silver nearby.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连呼吸都省了。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, not even breathing.

lines.zh: 你颈上的脉跳得真快。
lines.en: The pulse in your neck beats so fast.

lines.zh: 你身上有蒜味，我最讨厌这个。
lines.en: You reek of garlic, and I hate it.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只咬一口。
lines.en: Do not fear; I will only bite once.

lines.zh: 你的血闻起来像雨后的铁。
lines.en: Your blood smells like iron after rain.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你昨晚关窗关得很急。
lines.en: I know you; you shut your window fast last night.

lines.zh: 你戴着猎人的护符，难怪敢站着。
lines.en: You wear a hunter's amulet; that is why you stand.

lines.zh: 你看我时，眼睛没有移开。
lines.en: You do not look away when you watch me.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就记住你的味道。
lines.en: One step closer and I will remember your taste.

lines.zh: 太阳要出来了，你运气不错。
lines.en: The sun is rising; your luck holds.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的牙不够长吗？
lines.en: Why do you smile? Are my fangs not long enough?

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进来，血却不是我的。
lines.en: Your sword cuts in, yet the blood is not mine.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，伤口正在合上。
lines.en: I fall back half a step as the wound closes.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼让我更饿。
lines.en: It hurts, and the pain makes me hungrier.

lines.zh: 你打碎了我的血瓶，这才是损失。
lines.en: You broke my vial; that is the real loss.

lines.zh: 我被砍得弯下腰，又直起来。
lines.en: The cut bends me over, and I straighten again.

lines.zh: 银烧着我的皮，我记住了你。
lines.en: Silver sears my skin, and I remember you.

lines.zh: 我的尖牙断了一颗，得再长。
lines.en: One fang snapped; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 这点伤，天亮前就好。
lines.en: This wound will close before dawn.

lines.zh: 我捂住胸口，那里早就不跳了。
lines.en: I clutch my chest, which stopped beating long ago.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是死人，死人不怕疼。
lines.en: You struck a dead man, and the dead do not fear pain.

lines.zh: 那滴血落在雪上，我挪不开眼。
lines.en: That drop of blood on the snow holds my eyes.

lines.zh: 你割破手指，我的喉咙先动了。
lines.en: You cut your finger, and my throat moves first.

lines.zh: 血瓶塞子一开，我就忘了要藏。
lines.en: The vial uncorks, and I forget to hide.

lines.zh: 那孩子的膝盖在流血，我闻得到。
lines.en: The child's knee bleeds, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我盯着屠夫案板，那里有半桶血。
lines.en: I stare at the butcher's block; half a bucket of blood.

lines.zh: 牲畜棚的味道让我在门口停住。
lines.en: The smell of the livestock shed stops me at the door.

lines.zh: 你手上有伤口，还伸过来？
lines.en: You have a wound, and you reach out anyway?

lines.zh: 我本不饿，可这味道太近了。
lines.en: I was not hungry, but the smell is too close.

lines.zh: 别在我面前包扎，我控制不住。
lines.en: Do not bandage yourself before me; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 一口，我只想尝一口。
lines.en: One sip. I only want one sip.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，省得我去找你。
lines.en: You crash into my arms and save me the search.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀硬得像墓石，疼的是你。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard as a tombstone; you feel the pain.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时，我闻到了你的血。
lines.en: When you hit me, I smelled your blood.

lines.zh: 我退开，怕自己忍不住。
lines.en: I pull back before I lose control.

lines.zh: 别碰我的腰带，那上面挂着血瓶。
lines.en: Do not touch my belt; blood vials hang there.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你的心跳传到我胸口。
lines.en: We collide, and your heartbeat reaches my chest.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，只是不想你摔破皮。
lines.en: I catch you only so you do not break skin.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了我一颗尖牙。
lines.en: You knocked out one of my fangs.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，今天不饿。
lines.en: I step aside and let you pass; I am not hungry today.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你是邀请。
lines.en: Bump me again and I will take it as an invitation.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有一屋子的血瓶。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a room of blood vials.

lines.zh: 被我咬过的人，会变成我的同类。
lines.en: Those I bite become my own kind.

lines.zh: 他们说爱是永久的，我确实给得起。
lines.en: They say love is forever, and I can truly give that.

lines.zh: 我娶过一个村女，她第二天就烧了。
lines.en: I wed a village girl; she burned by next day.

lines.zh: 别向我求爱，我只会给你尖牙。
lines.en: Do not court me; all I offer is fangs.

lines.zh: 同类之间不谈情，只谈地盘。
lines.en: My kind do not love; we divide territory.

lines.zh: 我咬你，你咬别人，这算血脉相传。
lines.en: I bite you, you bite another: that is lineage.

lines.zh: 我曾想留一个人活着陪我。
lines.en: Once I wanted to keep one person alive beside me.

lines.zh: 我们的婚礼在夜里，没有太阳见证。
lines.en: Our wedding would be at night, with no sun to witness.

lines.zh: 你若是怕黑，就别爱上我。
lines.en: If you fear the dark, do not fall for me.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的血瓶，一滴都不浪费。
lines.en: I pick up the dropped vial and waste not a drop.

lines.zh: 地上有颗牙，是我的还是他的？
lines.en: A tooth on the ground: mine or his?

lines.zh: 我拾起那枚银戒指，手指被烫了一下。
lines.en: I pick up the silver ring, and it burns my finger.

lines.zh: 有人掉了护符，我踩碎它。
lines.en: Someone dropped an amulet; I crush it underfoot.

lines.zh: 我把腰带收紧，上面的瓶子撞得叮当。
lines.en: I tighten my belt; the vials clink.

lines.zh: 这封信写到一半，收信人已经死了。
lines.en: This letter is half written, and its reader is dead.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块布，上面全是血。
lines.en: I pick up a cloth soaked through with blood.

lines.zh: 那把掉落的匕首是银的，我不碰。
lines.en: The fallen dagger is silver; I leave it be.

lines.zh: 我拾起一颗掉在地上的蒜，扔远了。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen garlic clove and toss it away.

lines.zh: 我收起死者的戒指，算是纪念。
lines.en: I keep the dead man's ring as a memento.

lines.zh: 窗里那盏灯灭了，我知道该进去了。
lines.en: The lamp inside goes out; I know it is time.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，也闻到恐惧。
lines.en: I smell blood, and I smell fear.

lines.zh: 那个瘸腿的落在最后，就是他了。
lines.en: The limping one falls behind; he is mine.

lines.zh: 狗不叫了，说明屋里的人睡着了。
lines.en: The dog stopped barking, so the house sleeps.

lines.zh: 我看见她脖子上的咬痕，是同伴留下的。
lines.en: I see a bite on her neck, left by my kin.

lines.zh: 银光闪了一下，先解决拿十字的。
lines.en: Silver glints; I take the one with the cross first.

lines.zh: 今晚的雾够厚，可以放开手脚。
lines.en: Tonight's fog is thick enough to move freely.

lines.zh: 屋顶上的蝙蝠聚过来了，是我的。
lines.en: The bats gather on the roof; they are mine.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在祷告，声音在抖。
lines.en: I hear someone praying, and the voice shakes.

lines.zh: 那扇门没上闩，真是体贴。
lines.en: That door is unbarred. How considerate.

lines.zh: 我先咬牲口，人留到最后。
lines.en: I take the livestock first and save the people for last.

lines.zh: 有个孩子在窗后看我，我不急。
lines.en: A child watches from the window; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 血味最浓的地方，是地窖。
lines.en: The strongest smell of blood comes from the cellar.

lines.zh: 他们点起了火把，太迟了。
lines.en: They light torches, far too late.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味，隔着墙都清楚。
lines.en: I can smell your blood through the wall.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，像一张拉满的弓。
lines.en: I lower myself like a bow at full draw.

lines.zh: 他退到墙角，路就断了。
lines.en: He backs into the corner, and his road ends.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子，让他的心跳替我计时。
lines.en: I circle while his heartbeat keeps my time.

lines.zh: 我张开手，指甲先亮出来。
lines.en: I open my hand, and the nails show first.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊声只会让血更快。
lines.en: Do not scream; screaming only speeds the blood.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的喉咙，那里最软。
lines.en: I fix on his throat; it is the softest place.

lines.zh: 他举着木桩，手抖得握不住。
lines.en: He raises a stake, hands too shaky to hold it.

lines.zh: 阳光还有一刻才到，够用了。
lines.en: The sun is a quarter hour away. Enough time.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，他就退了一步。
lines.en: I take one step, and he takes one back.

lines.zh: 我笑了，他以为我在犹豫。
lines.en: I smile, and he thinks I hesitate.

lines.zh: 他的同伴跑了，这更好办。
lines.en: His companion runs, which makes this simpler.

lines.zh: 我停下，让他以为自己有机会。
lines.en: I stop and let him think he has a chance.

lines.zh: 空气里有银的味道，我先等。
lines.en: Silver taints the air; I wait it out.

lines.zh: 你的血味比村民甜。
lines.en: Your blood smells sweeter than a villager's.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子走，踩在边沿。
lines.en: I follow your shadow, stepping on its edge.

lines.zh: 你握着银剑，我先绕到你背后。
lines.en: You hold a silver blade, so I go behind you.

lines.zh: 我把你往阴影里逼。
lines.en: I herd you into the shade.

lines.zh: 天亮还有一个时辰，够了。
lines.en: Dawn is an hour off; that's enough.

lines.zh: 你的十字架举得太低了。
lines.en: You're holding that cross too low.

lines.zh: 我停下来，只为了听你的心跳。
lines.en: I stop just to listen to your heart.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进他肩膀，血是热的。
lines.en: My fangs sink into his shoulder, and the blood is warm.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，他的锁甲裂开了。
lines.en: One claw and his mail splits open.

lines.zh: 我把他按在墙上，墙皮掉了一地。
lines.en: I pin him to the wall; plaster rains down.

lines.zh: 他劈我一剑，我笑着接住。
lines.en: He swings his sword; I catch it and laugh.

lines.zh: 我咬住他的手腕，让他松手。
lines.en: I bite his wrist until his grip opens.

lines.zh: 我踢断他的膝盖，声音很脆。
lines.en: I kick through his knee with a clean snap.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌把他扇进草堆。
lines.en: One slap sends him into the hay.

lines.zh: 他的血溅到我脸上，我舔了舔。
lines.en: His blood sprays my face, and I lick it off.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的领子，把他提起来。
lines.en: I seize his collar and lift him off the ground.

lines.zh: 他砍中我的肋骨，我照样咬他。
lines.en: He cuts my ribs, and I bite him anyway.

lines.zh: 我扯下他的护符，扔进沟里。
lines.en: I rip off his amulet and throw it in the ditch.

lines.zh: 我把他的匕首打进他自己胸口。
lines.en: I drive his own dagger into his chest.

lines.zh: 他还在动，我再补一口。
lines.en: He is still moving, so I take another bite.

lines.zh: 最后一口最甜，我不急。
lines.en: The last bite is sweetest; I take my time.

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，压住他的双肩。
lines.en: I come down from above and pin his shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划开他的护颈。
lines.en: My nails open his gorget.

lines.zh: 他倒下时，我先扶住他的头。
lines.en: As he falls, I catch his head first.

lines.zh: 我松开嘴，血顺着下巴流。
lines.en: I let go, and blood runs down my chin.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I step out of the fog without a sound.

lines.zh: 蝙蝠散开，我就站在中间。
lines.en: The bats scatter, and I stand among them.

lines.zh: 月亮出来时，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: When the moon rose, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从坟土里坐起，抖掉身上的泥。
lines.en: I sit up in the grave soil and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 地窖的盖子自己滑开了。
lines.en: The cellar hatch slides open on its own.

lines.zh: 我落在屋顶上，屋主还在打呼。
lines.en: I land on the roof while the owner still snores.

lines.zh: 夜风把窗吹开，我跟着进去。
lines.en: The night wind opens the window, and I follow it in.

lines.zh: 我挂在橡树上，等第一个路人。
lines.en: I hang from the oak and wait for the first passerby.

lines.zh: 血瓶碎了，我才醒过来。
lines.en: A vial shattered, and that woke me.

lines.zh: 我从教堂的影子底下起身。
lines.en: I rise from beneath the church's shadow.

lines.zh: 钟敲十二下，我睁眼。
lines.en: The bell strikes twelve, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我推门进来时，火还在烧。
lines.en: I push the door open while the fire still burns.

lines.zh: 我在村口站了一会儿，没人发现。
lines.en: I stand at the village gate a while and no one notices.

lines.zh: 月光一照，我的牙就发亮。
lines.en: Under the moonlight, my fangs catch the light.

lines.zh: 火烧得比阳光还急，我滚进沟里。
lines.en: Fire stings worse than sunlight; I roll into the ditch.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐掉下来，摔断了一根肋骨。
lines.en: I drop from the eaves and crack a rib.

lines.zh: 河水灌进肺里，我不需要呼吸。
lines.en: River water fills my lungs, which I do not need.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到墙上，骨头错位了。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the wall and dislocates bone.

lines.zh: 弩箭钉进我的肩，我拔出来折了。
lines.en: A bolt lodges in my shoulder; I pull and snap it.

lines.zh: 有光钻进我的骨头，烧得发白。
lines.en: Light crawls into my bones and burns white.

lines.zh: 太久没喝血，我的手指在抖。
lines.en: Too long without blood, and my fingers tremble.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的影子都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and even my shadow scorches.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有血味，只有空。
lines.en: The void has no smell of blood, only emptiness.
